description:
List the payments the signed-in account has tracked, newest first.

One row per payment tracked in the last 90 days, at most 50 (`truncated`
is true when there are more): uetr, reference, amount, currency, status,
reason_code, sender_bic, receiver_bic, and last_tracked (ISO 8601, UTC).
Archived payments are not listed.

WHEN TO USE THIS:
  - The user refers to a payment they tracked before ("my payment", "my
    last transfer", "the EUR one to Hamburg") and gives no UETR or
    reference. Call this BEFORE asking for the payment's details, and ask
    only for what it does not settle.

The rows are the calling account's own: other users' and other
organisations' searches are never included. status is the last recorded
gpi status, not a live one; call track_payment for the current status.

Requires a signed-in account: Ohm on ohmyfin.ai, or an API key that
belongs to one user (an organisation-wide key has no payments of its own).

api_key.description: Your Ohmyfin API key (prod-...). Optional here: it can be sent instead as a KEY header or an Authorization: Bearer header. What the tool requires of the key is in its description.
